path_used: @excalidraw/excalidraw@0.18.1 (npm) bundled with Vite 6 into a static page served by 'vite preview' on :4324; Node scripts generate each scene as Excalidraw element skeletons (rectangles/ellipses/lines/arrows + bound text in containers); the page runs convertToExcalidrawElements -> exportToBlob (PNG) + serializeAsJSON (.excalidraw), driven by playwright-core 1.56.1 with /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194. Fonts served locally from public/fonts (copied from dist/prod/fonts), window.EXCALIDRAW_ASSET_PATH=location.origin+'/'. Font: Nunito (fontFamily 6), roughness 0.

steps: npm init; npm i @excalidraw/excalidraw@0.18.1 react@19.1.0 react-dom@19.1.0 vite@6.3.5 playwright-core@1.56.1
copy node_modules/@excalidraw/excalidraw/dist/prod/fonts -> public/fonts; set window.EXCALIDRAW_ASSET_PATH before the module loads
src/main.js exposes window.renderSkeleton (font warm-up export, convertToExcalidrawElements, exportToBlob, serializeAsJSON)
render.mjs: playwright-core launches /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194/chrome-linux/chrome, calls renderSkeleton, writes PNG + .excalidraw

font test: rendered the same Vietnamese sentence in all 7 Excalidraw fonts; Nunito (ships a Vietnamese unicode-range subset) renders all stacked diacritics correctly; Excalifont/Virgil (hand-drawn defaults) have no Vietnamese subset (fallback/mixed glyphs); Lilita mixes in fallback glyphs
problems: Default hand-drawn fonts (Excalifont, Virgil) have no Vietnamese subset, so fontFamily=6 (Nunito) has to be set on every text AND every container label; labels without it fell back to Excalifont in P1 attempt 1
Text has to be measured with the real font: a warm-up export was needed so Excalidraw loads Nunito before convertToExcalidrawElements measures text
Container labels auto-wrap and auto-grow the container: '10','11','12' wrapped inside 42px ellipses and stretched them (fixed by overlaying a transparent text container)
Only one weight (Nunito 500), no bold, no mixed sizes inside one text element; title/description hierarchy needs separate text elements
Exact canvas size achieved with a full-size white rectangle and exportPadding 0
measure.py peak RAM is ru_maxrss of children (largest single process), so Chromium multi-process RAM is under-reported

fixes: attempt 2: set Nunito on phase-pill and badge labels (they rendered in Excalifont); reduced card height/row spacing and enlarged phase slots so the phase pills no longer overlapped cards; moved the loop label off the right edge
attempt 3: the two-digit numbers 10-12 wrapped vertically inside the ellipse badges (container auto-grew), so the badge labels were replaced with transparent text containers; moved the loop label
limits: Loop label 'Vòng lặp: kết quả đo lường → tối ưu chu kỳ sau' still wraps its last word 'sau' onto a second line (left unfixed: 3-attempt cap)
Some descriptions wrap with a single orphan word (e.g. 'dung', 'hiệu', 'đăng')
Strict left/right alternation puts 9 (left) and 6 (right) on opposite sides, so the 'Chưa đạt → sửa lại' arrow is routed via the left margin and crosses into badge 6 on the axis

fixes: attempt 2: manual line breaks for long card titles (bad automatic wraps like 'Người duyệt chiến / lược'); taller cards so 3-line descriptions fit; moved the redo arc and labels
attempt 3: the redo arrow 9→6 ended ~45px short of badge 6, so the arc radius/angles were changed to start at 9 and end at 6; shifted the circle center down slightly
limits: Excalidraw has no arc primitive: the ring, phase arcs and curved arrows are polylines through computed points with curved roundness (approximate arcs)
No text on a path: phase names are straight text inside the ring, not along the arcs
Card text is small (14-17px) to fit 12 cards around a 1080px square; some descriptions wrap an orphan word ('hoạch', 'đăng')

fixes: attempt 2: human cards 4 and 9 widened 200→240px because their titles wrapped and overlapped the description; moved the 'Chưa đạt → sửa lại' label next to the vertical segment of the redo arrow
limits: 10 AI cards in one row at 1600px forces narrow 124px cards with 14-16px text and 2-4 line wraps
Arrows are hand-routed polylines (not bound/auto-routed to shapes); lanes and phase columns are plain rectangles/lines (no swimlane primitive)
The lower parts of both lanes have unused whitespace
